private static bool IsHcRouteLoss(Exception error) =>
        Unwrap(error).Any(item =>
            item.Message.Contains("HC_SESSION_ROUTE_LOST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            item.Message.Contains("hc-device-is-open-false", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            item.Message.Contains("route-marker-lost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

claims.conclusion: Only four-argument Main default body; named modes, FactoryCases and later constructor ports are excluded by exact argv. The LoadAssemblyAndFactory factory body is metadata for InitializationCallback selection, not an invocation root.

OneX/AYANEO/OpenLibSys/serial/manager event callbacks bind to the exact HC6d7 synthetic module; selected terminal methods contain no PInvoke or device/registry/process IO. Raw HC08a remains Cecil metadata only. Product source and original assertions unchanged.

Pinned synthetic hierarchy, declared owner/overload/return type/field contracts satisfy current OneX shim and old Light consumer. SerialPort belongs to HC6d7 even though its namespace matches System.IO.Ports. Missing optional exploration names are not required contract gaps.

Exact current factory ldftn resolves instance b__574_6; it invokes only current device.Initialize(false,false). Original source checks callback owner, parameter count, stage path, FirstStart/NewUpdate and exception propagation.

PrepareOriginalRestoreContext injects synthetic hcProfileTemplate. BuildPowerProfile clones it through synthetic manager CloneProfile; it does not capture/select a real profile or query IsPowerLineOnline. Empty restore duties bypass SetFanSpeed. ApplyCurveCore and watchdog polling are not default roots.

Harness fresh HWiNFO monitor only gets sampleReadTick and receives explicit temperature samples. Its ctor sets neither timer nor mapping/view; Start/Poll not reached. Dispose/InvalidateCachedMapping guards null timer/view/map. Events callback returns before watchdog work because watchdog is null.

Use the four per-engine state classes. Reopen-required is NOT universally false; the direct-close instances which set it do not arm Timer. Actual armed temperature failure instances cannot reach the reopen-controlled external replacement branch under the reviewed defaults.

HostOptions.Parse(empty) leaves ParentPid/ParentProcessName absent. CaptureParentEpisodeImagePath returns before Process.GetProcessById/GetProcessesByName. Engine constructor realBackend creation and runtimeDiagnosticsTimer guarded by RealBackend=false; later injected backend does not rewire constructor callbacks.

Main sets YEMANCC_SELFTEST_LOG_ROOT to result-parent/isolated-host-logs before loading targets. Diagnostic/fault/ledger paths use that root; StaticPowerObservationRuntimeIdentity hashes the loaded synthetic HC file. These owned file reads/writes remain real, permitted test IO; no blanket no-IO claim.
